plugins.name: agency-hub
plugins.description: Install first — bootstraps a git-versioned instance workspace (config/, brand/, squads/) via setup. Marketplace management is v2 — designed, deferred.

plugins.name: brand-creative
plugins.description: Complete brand practice in one install — setup interview, brand-voice lifecycle, and brand-guide visual identity. Writes to the instance brand/ directory when bound; standalone Try tier uses docs/brand/.

plugins.name: web-development
plugins.description: Complete web engineering practice in one install — setup interview, architecture, epic design, implementation, code review, QA, and platform operations. Six personas (Frontend Engineer through WebOps), one owned skill library. Reads brand-guide from resolved brand path; invokes delivery-practice for planning cadence.

plugins.name: product-management
plugins.description: Complete product management practice in one install — setup interview, product strategy and PRDs, roadmap, feature specs, user research synthesis, competitive analysis, product metrics, stakeholder updates, and brainstorming. One persona (Product Manager), one owned skill library. Hands off to delivery-practice for decomposition and sprint cadence.

plugins.name: delivery-practice
plugins.description: Complete delivery practice in one install — setup interview, tasks/backlog decomposition, sprint planning and retro, and epic validation. One persona (Delivery Lead), one owned skill library. Consumes product.md and roadmap.md from the companion product-management plugin.

plugins.name: content-marketing
plugins.description: Complete content practice in one install — setup interview, editorial calendar, social curation, media analysis, and CMS seed drafting. Two personas (Content Strategist, Content Writer), one owned skill library. Reads brand voice from resolved brand path; invokes delivery-practice for tasks and product-management for research synthesis.

plugins.name: ux-design
plugins.description: Minimal UX practice in one install — setup interview and wireframe skill for low-fidelity layout and interaction specs. Writes to the instance design/ directory when bound; standalone Try tier uses docs/design/.

plugins.name: search-optimisation
plugins.description: Complete search and technical SEO practice in one install — setup interview, keyword research, technical audits, and content SEO review. One persona (SEO Specialist), one owned skill library. Invokes product-management for competitive brief.
